title: India-US Trade Deal in the Last Stretch: What It Means for You
description_html:
India's External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar says trade talks with Washington are at the last stretch and most issues are resolved. We explain why the deal matters after the US tariffs on Indian exports, what the court decision on US tariffs changed, what India wants from a deal, how it affects exporters, investors and consumers in India, the US, Europe, Asia, the Gulf and Africa, what you should do, and where we land.
